name: Hour Hand
summary: A clock-dial pickup time picker whose sky, sun and city lights follow the time you choose
about: A pickup time picker for a bakery order. Drag the springy hand round the dial to set the hour, and it flips to minutes by itself; the digits roll, a green arc marks the hours the shop is open and a closed time is flagged at once. Above it, a little city sky moves from dawn to night with the sun, moon, stars and lit windows, and booking prints a ticket with a burst of sprinkles.
how: Drag the hand to an hour; when you let go it springs into place and switches to minutes
Press the hour or minute digits to switch, and AM or PM to change the half of the day
Focus the dial and use the arrow keys, Page Up/Down and Enter, or tap a quick pick such as Tea 4:30
Times outside 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM turn orange; press Book to get the pickup ticket, then Change time
